summary: The live sidebar loads optional row menus, reported-details dialogs and hover cards on demand, while roster navigation, search highlighting and badges remain in the initial bundle.

compatibility.detail: No API or wire change. Optional row actions and hover-card contents may wait for their chunk on first use; the roster remains interactive. A failed optional overlay or declaration chunk shows a local failure without unmounting the workspace; reopening retries the import without reloading the app.

downtime.detail: Takes effect with the next web build; no daemon restart is required.

recovery.detail: Revert this commit and rebuild the web app to restore eager row overlays.
